svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cone cup: 148 across the base, 244 across the lip, 192 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a plug the shape of the liner's outside (146 to 236 across,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 188 tall), sand it smooth and wax it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay up 4 mm of glass mat and epoxy over the plug; cure, trim the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lip square at 192 and pull the plug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: four 6 mm holes on a 60 mm circle, at 45 degrees to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: machine axes, for the bowl bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The shell is the outer mould for the liner (sketch 105).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After the liner is cast: drill about 89 holes of 1.0 mm through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shell and liner into the four ring grooves, more in the lower

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: grooves, so jacket water reaches every groove.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: wall 4 mm, plus or minus 0.5, all round (callipers at the lip).
